reply.summary: Raorieor is a gilt-masked young noble who rules a hidden mountain court and duels with a curved blade. He wins by bluffing first and cutting second, fighting only to humiliate rivals.

feats.scene: Raorieor splits a stone pillar with one diagonal slash to prove his court's loyalty.
Raorieor shrugs off a toppling balcony and keeps speaking without a scratch.

reply.summary: Tunum is a dream-haunting demon who works as a night-shift healer for cursed travellers. She slips between waking and sleeping to stitch wounds, bend hours and shield patients from nightmares.

feats.scene: Tunum folds an hour backward to undo a collapsing ward, flattening a house-sized area of dream-stuff.
Tunum absorbs a rival sorcerer's backlash while keeping a patient asleep and safe.

reply.summary: Torton is an infernal physician who borrows living bodies when her own wears out. Sworn to treat any injury, she hauls lost souls back from the brink with wry bedside patter.

feats.scene: Torton hurls a burst of crimson fire to burn out a plague nesting in a whole ward.
Torton walks through a collapsing infirmary wing and sets the bones of the trapped.

reply.summary: Taveia is a blank-eyed swordsman fused with a creeping vine after bargaining his life away to the wild. He hunts anyone the green world names as a trespasser, regrowing from any cut but the final one.

feats.scene: Taveia lashes a root-whip through a wooden gate and a rider beyond it.
Taveia is crushed under a toppled stone lantern and wriggles out whole.

reply.summary: Llcerosa is a quiet teacher of unarmed fighting who once sat on a secret advisory circle. He turns attackers' momentum against them and rarely needs more than a single throw.

feats.scene: Llcerosa flips a heavy opponent over his hip onto a wooden floor.
Llcerosa takes a thrown chair across the shoulders and keeps his stance.

reply.summary: Rinaune is a teenage student who inherits a hunting spear haunted by a long-dead knight. Together they hurl it with ringing accuracy, though she is still learning to listen to its advice.

feats.scene: Rinaune throws the spear through a dragon-scaled gate and pins the beast behind it.
Rinaune stands unhurt in a crumbling hall while ancient beams thud around her.

reply.summary: Lessor is a former scribe turned junior officer in a displaced city's army. Competent but unflashy, she carries a long-range rifle and keeps her squad alive with steady orders.

feats.scene: Lessor fires a rifle volley that cracks open an armoured transport.
Lessor rides out a vehicle rollover and gets back to her feet to give orders.

reply.summary: Riaserasi is a violet-skinned farmer turned ring-bearing space warden who hunts blood-drinking monsters across his home sector. Bereaved by a fanged killer, he answers fear with a stubborn joke and a green glow.

feats.scene: Riaserasi condenses a gigantic stake of light and drives it through a vampire fortress-ship.
Riaserasi weathers a fleet's barrage inside his ring's shield.
Riaserasi streaks between two moons in a few minutes.

reply.summary: Iuteleo is a bitter young arsonist raised among fire-setters, now a bully in a care home. She covers her fear with taunts and matches.

feats.scene: Iuteleo sets a family house ablaze until nothing but the foundation is left.
Iuteleo is knocked flat by a door and sits up laughing.

reply.summary: Erutati is a day-care worker and financier who can speak directly to machines and rewrite what they do. She changes names and faces like coats and skips town whenever suspicion arrives.

feats.scene: Erutati overloads a data-centre's power feed so the building's windows burst.
Erutati tumbles down a flight of stairs and walks away bruised.

reply.summary: Ronaulta is a detective who reads criminals' habits from the way they leave a room. She grew up around lawmen and carries a quiet grief over a father lost to a bad guess.

feats.scene: Ronaulta shoves a suspect against a squad car hard enough to knock the wind out of him.
Ronaulta takes a glancing blow from a pipe and still cuffs her man.

reply.summary: Telvaltor is a veteran investigator who left federal service for a city force after a family tragedy. She is patient, observant and relentless with a case file and a cup of cold coffee.

feats.scene: Telvaltor tackles a runner across a parking lot and pins him.
Telvaltor is thrown through a shop window and keeps hold of the evidence.

reply.summary: Anrnu is an ageing mountain-dwelling scientist chasing deathlessness with grafted machine parts and a floating chair. His obsession ruined his family and finally his own laboratory.

feats.scene: Anrnu detonates his experimental reactor and levels the laboratory above a cave.
Anrnu survives a fall down a stone stairwell thanks to his reinforced frame.

reply.summary: Tacoveo is a towering winged monarch who commands a horned legion of divine soldiers. He can grow to colossal size, wields a flaming staff and once held back a cosmic tyrant for an extended stretch at the edge of reality.

feats.scene: Tacoveo swings his burning staff and cracks a world-sized rift open.
Tacoveo endures a god-king's blows through an entire sustained duel.

reply.summary: Narniani is a yellow-eyed demon lord born from a forbidden union and driven to crawl back into the womb that made him. He steals souls, lends power to mortals and shifts shape to hide among ordinary people.

feats.scene: Narniani tears a hellish veil across a whole apartment block and drags tenants into it.
Narniani shrugs off a binding verse that would have shattered a lesser fiend.

reply.summary: Antil is a calm envoy chosen to visit a secluded island of warrior women. He returned home arguing for open doors and shared meals.

feats.scene: Antil bangs a lectern to call a noisy hall to order.
Antil falls from a stage during sabotage and rises to finish his speech.

reply.summary: Liasirus is a scaly gang enforcer whose body moves and strikes like a serpent. He slithers through tight spaces and hits with sudden venomous speed.

feats.scene: Liasirus lunges across a warehouse in a single coil-and-strike motion.
Liasirus takes a baton to the ribs with a hiss and keeps coming.
Liasirus whips down a corridor faster than a sprinter.

reply.summary: Ianco is a murdered sister whose ghost builds a gold-and-silver mechanical body inside a drifting asteroid. Mistaking a lookalike for a possessed corpse, she rules the void with a metal serpent until her truth is spoken.

feats.scene: Ianco collapses a rocky outcrop into molten ore to forge a shell for her spirit.
Ianco lets a rescue party batter her metal frame without flinching.

reply.summary: Illrantor is a stolen daughter of a warrior kingdom who forgot her past and became chieftain of space nomads. She fights hard, trusts nobody and breaks when a magic cord reveals who she was.

feats.scene: Illrantor crushes a battle-wagon wheel in her fist during a charge.
Illrantor shakes off a lance strike that dents a steel door.

reply.summary: Tetolu is a blond star-roving instructor who ferries knowledge home to her island sisters. She carries a beam pistol and a sword, and gives her life sealing a gate to the underworld.

feats.scene: Tetolu hauls a stone gate shut against a tide of damned souls.
Tetolu withstands a swarm of clawing fiends long enough to finish her task.

reply.summary: Riaiar is a ruthless heir who seizes a small kingdom and fills its camps with the unwanted. Drawing strength from the soil beneath him, he hurls fire and rock until a stronger champion topples him.

feats.scene: Riaiar heaves up a hillside of burning earth onto an advancing column.
Riaiar tanks a barrage of artillery while his boots stay planted on native ground.

reply.summary: Carva is a legendary shield-bearer who held a vast host at bay in plated gold so her people could flee. Long believed lost, she lives quietly among strangers and keeps her gifts hidden.

feats.scene: Carva hurls a battering ram of enemy soldiers across a river valley.
Carva stands in her golden plates as a whole army's weapons break against her.
Carva races along a canyon wall faster than sound.

reply.summary: Lanora is an ancient champion who now designs towers and halls. She helps a sea-king raise great spires that can call across the world, and warns that shouting loudly invites hungry listeners.

feats.scene: Lanora lifts a massive stone block onto a tower foundation by herself.
Lanora holds a collapsing archway above her workers until they clear out.

reply.summary: Lallati is a blue-skinned red-eyed fiend who rules a gloomy pit and schemes with honeyed lies. Strong and sturdy, he fears only cold metal.

feats.scene: Lallati smashes a stone altar flat with a single downward fist.
Lallati stands in a lava-fall and complains about the draught.

reply.summary: Lisrator is a white-haired warrior from far beyond this world who heals a burned wanderer and trains him for years. Before dying he hands over a mantle of cosmic power to his pupil.

feats.scene: Lisrator channels a glowing wave that flash-heals a charred stranger and levels the ridge around them.
Lisrator withstands a rival's final onslaught long enough to pass on his gift.

reply.summary: Viseval is a pale goddess who feeds on the shared life of her homeland and leaves only dust. Her fatal mistake is draining her own people and world to beat an invader, then serving him in guilt.

feats.scene: Viseval drinks every living thing on her homeworld and lets the husk crumble into nothing.
Viseval is skewered through the torso and keeps muttering.

reply.summary: Reoium is a hairless yellow-eyed keeper of a device that could end all creation. Self-sustaining and able to project raw force, he stays awake for ages until a blade finally ends his watch.

feats.scene: Reoium flares a lance of pure force that carves a crater across a dead moon.
Reoium lets a sun-hot barrage break around him and holds his post.

reply.summary: Lucorria is a swordsman who bursts into a hulking fire-wreathed brute when pushed. A loyal pack member, he fights with both skill and heat.

feats.scene: Lucorria bursts into flame and brings a wooden watchtower down in one swing.
Lucorria wades through a fusillade in monster form and laughs.

reply.summary: Aseruser is a grey-haired earth-mother who commands surf, soil and thunder from a hidden town of forgotten sea deities. She knows the shape of the many worlds and answers disrespect with weather.

feats.scene: Aseruser raises a storm-wall that floods the whole shoreline of a continent.
Aseruser walks unmarked through a sinking tide of her own making.

reply.summary: Ianntva is a shaven-headed swordswoman from a cult of warrior nuns, loyal to a ruling matriarch. She excels in close combat and keeps her blade bright.

feats.scene: Ianntva cleaves a wooden practice dummy in half with a single stroke.
Ianntva keeps fighting after a hard kick lands in her ribs.

reply.summary: Asleotor is a blond warrior queen who gave up a throne to walk alone preaching balance and fairness. Each solstice she turned back raiders from a shadowy realm at a mountain gate.

feats.scene: Asleotor smashes the stone arch of a portal to seal it against invaders.
Asleotor holds a ridge-top pass against a whole night's assault.

reply.summary: Coreran is a secret child raised in a guild of killers, skilled in many fighting arts and cunning in plots. Once seemingly lost in a blast, she returns revived from a green pool.

feats.scene: Coreran drives a staff through a thick plank door in one strike.
Coreran stands near a detonating giant and is thrown yards but later returns after a revival bath.

reply.summary: Arnteosa is a veiled archer who leads a breakaway band of assassins and fights with focus, discipline and an arsenal of trick arrows. She endures pain without complaint and expects obedience.

feats.scene: Arnteosa nails a moving target from the far end of a dockside shed.
Arnteosa continues a duel after taking a blade to her thigh.

reply.summary: Stiumanu is a wise goddess among five mothers who fashioned a sheltered island and its warrior people. She cannot fully step into the physical world and gives her gifts through others.

feats.scene: Stiumanu shapes a whole island from empty sea and breathes life into a clay child.
Stiumanu endures an unfolding catastrophe with calm advice.

reply.summary: Eoirnt is a brilliant young woman in a bunny outfit who delights in meeting her own counterpart from another timeline. She is clever, curious and loyal to her partner.

feats.scene: Eoirnt swats a gadget off a table in excitement.
Eoirnt tumbles through a laboratory shelf and laughs.

reply.summary: Vauleo is a platinum-haired teenager who nearly gets caught in an airport shooting alongside her father and sister. She is ordinary, brave and trusting in a hero's rescue.

feats.scene: Vauleo shoves her sister behind a luggage cart.
Vauleo hits the tiled floor hard and gets up shaking.

reply.summary: Iallin is a blond, cheerful heroine with extraordinary strength inherited from a hidden tribe of warrior women. She is the muscle of a bumbling team and not always the sharpest, but she hits like a truck.

feats.scene: Iallin lifts a parked bus and tosses it over a fence.
Iallin is rammed by a runaway van and dusts herself off.

reply.summary: Reotau is a cartoon strongwoman on a team of useless crimefighters who trips over her own good intentions. She returns a stolen handbag to the thief, which says everything about her.

feats.scene: Reotau bats a runaway cart across an alley without noticing.
Reotau takes a cartoon anvil to the head and smiles.

reply.summary: Llstu is a blond sports coach who trains girls in leaping, racing and wrestling on a hidden island. Her gentle lessons teach one strong child restraint.

feats.scene: Llstu hurls a javelin clean through a wooden target post.
Llstu catches a falling hurdle without a wince.
Llstu wins a footrace over the track in record time.

reply.summary: Luria is a blue-haired guardian who trained as a god-chosen successor and later protects a distant world in a fallen friend's memory. A power suit amplifies his gifts of flight, strength and storm-summoning.

feats.scene: Luria calls a lightning squall that scours a mountain valley clean.
Luria stands unbroken inside the heart of a collapsing planet-shield.
Luria climbs into the stratosphere in seconds.

reply.summary: Rniseanu is a past sea-king remembered mainly for kindly welcoming an exile into his drowned realm. He shows his power in history rather than in battle.

feats.scene: Rniseanu thumps a staff on the throne room floor to hush the court.
Rniseanu rides out crushing deep-sea pressure on his daily commute.

reply.summary: Lliternu is a loving mother who flies with her son over open ocean and is struck down by a monstrous singer. She unclips the boy and sends him away with a small keepsake before the water takes her.

feats.scene: Lliternu rips a seat belt loose from a bent frame to free her son.
Lliternu survives a plane tearing apart long enough to push her boy clear.

reply.summary: Nanau is an exiled sea-queen who flees a coup with her half-surface infant. Hunted along a shoreline, she is mortally wounded by a summoned wave and entrusts her boy to kindly strangers.

feats.scene: Nanau drives back a squad of raiders along the beach with a trident sweep.
Nanau crawls through collapsed streets after a tidal wave wrecks the town.

reply.summary: Stotinan is an ageless scientist who survived a continent's drowning by brewing a breathing serum. Living in seclusion and later ruling beside a sea-king, she watches children and grandchildren come and go.

feats.scene: Stotinan pushes a sunken vault door aside and lets a sealed laboratory flood open.
Stotinan endures deep-sea pressure for centuries without fading.

reply.summary: Terlati is a grey-eyed demigod of desire and unions who founds a free-living cult in a quiet suburb. Resentful of a mother's pride, they speak of lust and life as one thing.

feats.scene: Terlati whips a crowd into rapture and bends a block of homes into one shared dream.
Terlati takes a divine blade without bleeding.

reply.summary: Auiumsi is a swordsman in a team resisting a coiling cosmic threat. He is quick and precise, and fights in fencing form.

feats.scene: Auiumsi skewers a charging drone with a lunge.
Auiumsi takes a glancing laser burn and parries on.
Auiumsi darts across a rooftop in a single leap.

reply.summary: Tiast is a masked hero who joins a veteran team to quell a prison riot. He arrives together with the squad and gets caught in the blast that frees the inmates.

feats.scene: Tiast punches through a prison wall to reach captives.
Tiast stands up out of a blasted wing.

reply.summary: Sioroeo is a blond titan condemned to carry the sky on his shoulders forever. His endurance is so great that he shares a measure of it with a boy who shouts a magic word.

feats.scene: Sioroeo heaves a mountain-sized slab off his back and sets it down again.
Sioroeo props up the whole sky without rest across the ages.

reply.summary: Iumcois is a huge bearded champion whose crystal-fed muscle came to him when his father fell. He wanders the world freeing the oppressed under a manager's watchful eye and lives to settle scores with a tyrant.

feats.scene: Iumcois shatters a stone wall with a single swing.
Iumcois laughs off a stampede and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Nusamst is a grey-haired elder god in a council who lends strength and stamina to a chosen young hero. His power is old, quiet and given freely.

feats.scene: Nusamst slams his staff down and splits a mountain in two.
Nusamst stands in the crater of a destroyed range and does not stagger.
